description.narrative: This project is to Mitigate localized Resource-based Conflicts and increase Community Resilience in selected chiefdoms in Pujehun and Moyamba Districts of Sierra Leone.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).
UNDP as the Implementing Partner will comply with the policies, procedures and practices of the United Nations Security Management System (UNSMS.)

description.narrative:
Outcome 1: Communities in Pujehun and Moyamba districts benefit from more accountable institutions and mechanisms that promote peaceful relations between communities and private companies.
1 (a): Level of perception of effectiveness of Multi Stakeholder Platforms (MSPs) in addressing grievances from communities and companies (disaggregated by sex and age). 1 (b): Level of collaboration between communities and companies (disaggregated by sex and age of respondent). 1 (c): Level of collaboration between communities and local platforms.
Output 1.1: Land acquisition and land use processes are more inclusive and aligned with policy frameworks
1.1.1: Land conflict and degradation analyses for 4 targeted chiefdoms completed to identify common ground for dialogue. 1.1.2: Number of community stakeholders (disaggregated by gender and age) trained on existing regulatory framework on land acquisition. 1.1.3 a: Simplified checklist developed. 1.1.3 b: Number of community members trained on use of simplified checklist (disaggregated by gender). 1.1.4: # of policy initiatives for SLEITI and VGGT adopted based on international best practices.
Output 1.2: Infrastructure for mediation and dialogue strengthened to manage conflicts within and between communities and companies.
1.2.1: Percentage of community members that utilized Grievance Redress Committee services satisfied with outcome (disaggregated by gender and location). 1.2.2: Percentage of community development committees with inclusive membership (minimum of 30 percent women). 1.2.3: # of district-level MSPs meetings held on quarterly basis. 1.2.4: Percentage of women and youth attending MSP meetings.
Output 1.3: Strengthen the capacity of government, security sector, local leaders and companies to be more accountable to communities:
1.3.1: Number of SLEITI and VGGT coordination meetings held. 1.3.2: Percentage of Local Police Partnership Board meetings held on a monthly basis. 1.3.3: # of company staff from respect

Output 1.1: Land acquisition and land use processes are more inclusive and aligned with policy frameworks
Output 1.1: 4 Conflict and land degradation analyses completed. Stakeholders meeting held to review report and plan for the validation of the report in 2022. Output 1.2: 248 Community people trained on legal education on land rights, acquisition and use. Output 1.3: 2 simplified checklists have not been received. Output 1.4: Some SLEITI and VGGT meetings were held, however, no policy initiatives have commenced
Output 1.2: Infrastructure for mediation and dialogue strengthened to manage conflicts within and between communities and companies. Output 1.2.1: This indicator is difficult to record or aggregate. Matters brought to GRC meetings were not interogated to determine numbers of beneficiaries or their level of satisfaction. For example, a matter was addressed based on the relevant parties summoned for a hearing. discussions were not held about how many benefiaries benefited for a resolution on land disputes or issues with surface rents for example. A perception survey will be conducted at the end of the project to determine level of trust and satisfaction. Output 1.2.2: Community Development committees exist for Lower Banta (Sierra Rutile) and Upper Banta (Vimetco) in Moyamba District as well as for Malen (Socfin) and Makpele (Natural Habitat) in Pujehun District. Total CDC numbers 96 (67males 29 females) = 30.2% females; Moyamba 60 (35male 25 female) = 41.7% females; Pujehun 36 (32 males 4 females) = 11.1% Output 1.2.3: 4 MSP meetings in Moyamba; 3 MSP meetings in Pujehun; Totals = 7 MSP meetings Output 1.2.4: MSP attendance - Total = 105 (45 males, 45 female, 15 youths). Women and youth % = 57% Moyamba = 50 (15 males, 20 females, 15 youths). Women & youth % = 70%; Pujehun = 55 (30 males, 25 females). Women & youth % = 45.5%
Output 1.3: Strengthen the capacity of government, security sector, local leaders and companies to be more accountable to communities: Output 1.3.1: It was reported that 2 SLEITI and VGGT meetings were held, and some minutes have been shared with UNDP.
Output 1.3.2: LPPBs in the two targeted Districts have been trained and operationally supported. Reports on the implementation of their Actions Plans will be shared with UNDP in 2022. Output 1.3.3: Human Rights Commission conducted two sets of trainings in the two targeted Districts. Follow-ups will be done to see the impact of the trainings.
